title: Raajsee Cheese Cloths Grade 100, 12 Sq Feet - 1.4 Sq Yards Unbleached 100% Organic Cotton Fabric - Reusable Ultra Fine Mesh Muslin Cloth - Cheesecloth For Straining Cooking,Baking,Cheese Making
description:
About this item
ULTRA FINE GRADE 100 CHEESECLOTH: Discover Raajsee's renowned natural, organic home essentials. Featuring a high thread count weave (51x55 threads per inch), our ultra-fine mesh cheese cloth effectively filters impurities. It's durable, tear-resistant, and effortlessly washable for repeated use.
100% NATURAL UNBLEACHED COTTON: Indulge in our chef-grade cheesecloth, woven from 100% unbleached organic cotton. Free from chemicals, bleach, or dyes, it ensures food safety and reliability. ideal for cottage cheese, yogurt, and turkey and more without leaving any stains.
CUT AS PER YOUR NEED: Our 45" x 40" (1.4 sq yard) muslin cloths offer 30% more fabric than competitors (1 sq yard).with two side hemmed edges,offers versatility with no pre-cuts. Cut it freely to your desired size for spice bag, nut milk bags or paneer Cheese making reducing waste.
LINT-FREE PERFECTION : Crafted solely from virgin cotton, our cheese cloth guarantees the highest quality and a lint-free experience. With no recycled fibres or impurities, use it confidently for multiple layers of filtration. Seamlessly overlap hemmed pieces for efficient filtering, ensuring culinary perfection.
Versatile Household Essential: From spice bags to cheese-making, canning to poultry preparation, our cheesecloth serves a multitude of household and professional purposes. Ideal for kombucha scoby, roasting turkeys, straining yogurt, and more, it's an indispensable tool for culinary excellence.
